Copepoda. Source taxonomy retained: within the Family Calanoidae, common genera include Calanus, Neocalanus, and Mesocalanus. Within the Family Eucalanidae are the genera Ecucalanus, Rhincalanus, and Paracalnus. Within Family Pseudocalanidae are the genera Clausocalanus, Ctenocalanus, and Pseudocalanus. Family Aetideidae contains the genera Aetideopsis, Aetideus, Chiridius, Euchirella, and Gaetanus, and Family Euchatetidae contains genus Euchaeta. Family Metridiidae contains genera Metridia, Pleuromamma, Centropages, Pachyptilus, Candacia, Epilabidocera, and Acartia.
